verses.greek: Ἰούδας Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοῦλος, ἀδελφὸς δὲ Ἰακώβου, τοῖς ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ ἠγαπημένοις καὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ τετηρημένοις κλητοῖς·
verses.literal: Jude of Jesus Christ servant brother then of James To those in God the Father loved and in Jesus Christ kept called
verses.dgt: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those who are called, loved in God the Father and kept for Jesus Christ:

verses.greek: ἔλεος ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἀγάπη πληθυνθείη.
verses.literal: Mercy to you and peace and love would be multiplied.
verses.dgt: May mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ποιούμενος γράφειν ὑμῖν περὶ τῆς κοινῆς ἡμῶν σωτηρίας ἀνάγκην ἔσχον γράψαι ὑμῖν παρακαλῶν ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι τῇ ἅπαξ παραδοθείσῃ τοῖς ἁγίοις πίστει.
verses.literal: Beloved all diligence using to write to you concerning the shared of us salvation necessity I had to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the once for all having been delivered to the saints faith.
verses.dgt: Beloved, while making every effort to write to you about our common salvation, I found it necessary to write, urging you to contend for the faith once for all delivered to the saints.

verses.greek: παρεισέδυσαν γάρ τινες ἄνθρωποι, οἱ πάλαι προγεγραμμένοι εἰς τοῦτο τὸ κρίμα, ἀσεβεῖς, τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν χάριτα μετατιθέντες εἰς ἀσέλγειαν καὶ τὸν μόνον δεσπότην καὶ κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἀρνούμενοι.
verses.literal: Came in stealthily for certain men those long ago designated unto this the condemnation ungodly ones the of the God of us grace changing into sensuality and the only master and Lord of us Jesus Christ denying.
verses.dgt: For certain people have slipped in unnoticed, those long ago designated for this judgment: ungodly people who turn the grace of our God into sensuality and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: Ὑπομνῆσαι δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι, εἰδότας ὑμᾶς ἅπαξ πάντα, ὅτι Ἰησοῦς λαὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σώσας τὸ δεύτερον τοὺς μὴ πιστεύσαντας ἀπώλεσεν,
verses.literal: To remind now you I want knowing you once everything that Ἰησοῦς a people out of the land of Egypt having saved the afterward those not having believed He destroyed.
verses.dgt: Now I want to remind you, though you once knew all this, that Jesus, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

verses.greek: ἀγγέλους τε τοὺς μὴ τηρήσαντας τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀρχὴν ἀλλὰ ἀπολιπόντας τὸ ἴδιον οἰκητήριον εἰς κρίσιν μεγάλης ἡμέρας δεσμοῖς ἀϊδίοις ὑπὸ ζόφον τετήρηκεν·
verses.literal: The angels both the not having kept the their own domain but having left the their own dwelling unto the judgment of the great day in chains eternal under darkness He has kept
verses.dgt: And angels who did not keep their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

verses.greek: ὡς Σόδομα καὶ Γόμορρα καὶ αἱ περὶ αὐτὰς πόλεις, τὸν ὅμοιον τρόπον τούτοις ἐκπορνεύσασαι καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἑτέρας, πρόκεινται δεῖγμα πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχουσαι.
verses.literal: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the around them cities the in like manner with them having indulged in sexual immorality and having gone after flesh strange are set forth as an example of fire eternal the penalty undergoing.
verses.dgt: Likewise Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having indulged in sexual immorality in the same way as these and gone after other flesh, are set forth as an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.

verses.greek: Ὁμοίως μέντοι καὶ οὗτοι ἐνυπνιαζόμενοι σάρκα μὲν μιαίνουσιν, κυριότητα δὲ ἀθετοῦσιν, δόξας δὲ βλασφημοῦσιν.
verses.literal: Likewise yet also these dreaming ones the flesh indeed defile authority however they set aside glorious ones however they blaspheme.
verses.dgt: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile the flesh, reject authority, and blaspheme glorious ones.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ Μιχαὴλ ὁ ἀρχάγγελος, ὅτε τῷ διαβόλῳ διακρινόμενος διελέγετο περὶ τοῦ Μωϋσέως σώματος, οὐκ ἐτόλμησεν κρίσιν ἐπενεγκεῖν βλασφημίας, ἀλλὰ εἶπεν· Ἐπιτιμήσαι σοι κύριος.
verses.literal: the But Michael the archangel when with the devil disputing he was reasoning about the Moses’ body not did dare a judgment to bring against him blasphemy but said Would that he rebuke you the Lord.
verses.dgt: But Michael the archangel, when disputing with the devil he argued about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a blasphemous judgment against him, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you.”

verses.greek: οὗτοι δὲ ὅσα μὲν οὐκ οἴδασιν βλασφημοῦσιν, ὅσα δὲ φυσικῶς ὡς τὰ ἄλογα ζῷα ἐπίστανται, ἐν τούτοις φθείρονται.
verses.literal: These however as much as indeed not they understood they denigrate as much as however naturally as the irrational animals they understand in these things they corrupt themselves.
verses.dgt: But these people blaspheme whatever they do not understand, and whatever they know instinctively, like irrational animals, by these things they are being destroyed.

verses.greek: οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς, ὅτι τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Κάϊν ἐπορεύθησαν, καὶ τῇ πλάνῃ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ μισθοῦ ἐξεχύθησαν, καὶ τῇ ἀντιλογίᾳ τοῦ Κόρε ἀπώλοντο.
verses.literal: Woe to them because in the way the of Cain they went and to the error the of Balaam for reward they rushed and in the rebellion the of Korah they perished.
verses.dgt: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, rushed into the error of Balaam for profit, and perished in the rebellion of Korah.

verses.greek: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐν ταῖς ἀγάπαις ὑμῶν σπιλάδες συνευωχούμενοι, ἀφόβως ἑαυτοὺς ποιμαίνοντες, νεφέλαι ἄνυδροι ὑπὸ ἀνέμων παραφερόμεναι, δένδρα φθινοπωρινὰ ἄκαρπα δὶς ἀποθανόντα ἐκριζωθέντα,
verses.literal: These are the ones in the love feasts of you hidden reefs feasting together with you fearlessly themselves shepherding clouds without water by winds being carried away trees autumnal without fruit twice having died having been uprooted
verses.dgt: These are hidden reefs at your love feasts, feasting with you without fear, shepherding themselves; waterless clouds carried along by winds; late-autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, uprooted;

verses.greek: κύματα ἄγρια θαλάσσης ἐπαφρίζοντα τὰς ἑαυτῶν αἰσχύνας, ἀστέρες πλανῆται οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους εἰς αἰῶνα τετήρηται.
verses.literal: waves wild of the sea foaming out the their own shame stars wandering to whom the gloom the of darkness to age has been reserved.
verses.dgt: wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept forever.

verses.greek: Προεφήτευσεν δὲ καὶ τούτοις ἕβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ Ἑνὼχ λέγων· Ἰδοὺ ἦλθεν κύριος ἐν ἁγίαις μυριάσιν αὐτοῦ,
verses.literal: He prophesied then also to these the seventh from Adam Enoch saying: Behold has come the Lord amidst holy ones myriads of His
verses.dgt: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about these people, saying, “Look, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

verses.greek: ποιῆσαι κρίσιν κατὰ πάντων καὶ ἐλέγξαι πάντας τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς περὶ πάντων τῶν ἔργων ἀσεβείας αὐτῶν ὧν ἠσέβησαν καὶ περὶ πάντων τῶν σκληρῶν ὧν ἐλάλησαν κατʼ αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀσεβεῖς.
verses.literal: to carry out judgment against all and to convict πάντας the ἀσεβεῖς concerning all the works of ungodliness of them in which they have been ungodly and concerning all the harsh things that spoke against Him sinners ungodly.
verses.dgt: to execute judgment against all and to convict all the ungodly concerning all their deeds of ungodliness that they committed in an ungodly way, and concerning all the harsh things ungodly sinners spoke against him.”

verses.greek: οὗτοί εἰσιν γογγυσταί, μεμψίμοιροι, κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι, καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν λαλεῖ ὑπέρογκα, θαυμάζοντες πρόσωπα ὠφελείας χάριν.
verses.literal: These are grumblers discontented after the lusts of themselves following and the mouth of them speaks great swelling words flattering faces of profit because.
verses.dgt: These are grumblers, complainers, walking according to their own desires; their mouth speaks arrogant things, flattering people for the sake of advantage.

verses.greek: Ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀγαπητοί, μνήσθητε τῶν ῥημάτων τῶν προειρημένων ὑπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.literal: You yourselves however beloved do remember the declarations which spoken beforehand by the apostles of the Lord of us Jesus Christ
verses.dgt: But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.greek: ὅτι ἔλεγον ὑμῖν· Ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου χρόνου ἔσονται ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ἐπιθυμίας πορευόμενοι τῶν ἀσεβειῶν.
verses.literal: for they were saying to you on this last time there will be scoffers after the their own passions following the of ungodlinesses.
verses.dgt: that they were saying to you, “In the last time there will be scoffers walking according to their own ungodly desires.”

verses.greek: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀποδιορίζοντες, ψυχικοί, πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες.
verses.literal: These are those causing divisions worldly-minded the Spirit not having.
verses.dgt: These are the ones who cause divisions, natural people, not having the Spirit.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀγαπητοί, ἐποικοδομοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς τῇ ἁγιωτάτῃ ὑμῶν πίστει, ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ προσευχόμενοι,
verses.literal: you yourselves however beloved building up yourselves in the most holy of you faith in the Spirit Holy praying
verses.dgt: But you, beloved, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,

verses.greek: ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἀγάπῃ θεοῦ τηρήσατε προσδεχόμενοι τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
verses.literal: yourselves in the love of God do keep awaiting the mercy of the Lord of us Jesus Christ unto life eternal.
verses.dgt: keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.

verses.greek: καὶ οὓς μὲν ἐλεᾶτε διακρινομένους,
verses.literal: And those who indeed do have mercy on are doubting
verses.dgt: And have mercy on some who are doubting;

verses.greek: οὓς δὲ σῴζετε ἐκ πυρὸς ἁρπάζοντες, οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε ἐν φόβῳ, μισοῦντες καὶ τὸν ἀπὸ τῆς σαρκὸς ἐσπιλωμένον χιτῶνα.
verses.literal: others however do save from fire snatching to others then do show mercy with fear hating even the by the flesh stained clothing.
verses.dgt: save others by snatching them out of the fire; and have mercy on others with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.

verses.greek: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ φυλάξαι ὑμᾶς ἀπταίστους καὶ στῆσαι κατενώπιον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἀμώμους ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει
verses.literal: To Him now being able to keep you from stumbling and to present you in the presence of the glory of Him blameless with exultation —
verses.dgt: Now to the one who is able to keep you from stumbling and to make you stand before his glory blameless with great joy,

verses.greek: μόνῳ θεῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν δόξα μεγαλωσύνη κράτος καὶ ἐξουσία πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.
verses.literal: to the only God Savior of us through Jesus Christ the Lord of us be glory majesty dominion and authority before all the age and now and to all the ages Amen.
verses.dgt: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority, before all time and now and into all the ages. Amen.
